ping: cmd-006 popup fix - re-register all Claude tasks hidden

commands.label: fix_popup_tasks
commands.cmd: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$vbs='C:\Users\endos\Signal\relay\run_hidden.vbs'; $tasks=@( @{name='ClaudeRAMTrimLoop'; script='C:\Users\endos\Signal\relay\ram_trim.ps1'}, @{name='RelayAutoSync'; script='C:\Users\endos\Signal\relay\relay_poller.ps1'}, @{name='Cloud_DC_Watchdog'; script='C:\Users\endos\Signal\relay\dc_watchdog.ps1'}, @{name='SLC_LaptopMonitor'; script='C:\Users\endos\Signal\relay\laptop_monitor.ps1'}, @{name='SLC_FxtCleanup'; script='C:\Users\endos\Signal\relay\fxt_cleanup.ps1'} ); foreach($t in $tasks){ try{ $existing=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $t.name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($existing -and (Test-Path $t.script)){ $action=New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'wscript.exe' -Argument \"`"$vbs`" `"$($t.script)`"\"; Set-ScheduledTask -TaskName $t.name -Action $action -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host \"Updated $($t.name) to hidden VBS\" }elseif($existing){ $action=New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument \"-WindowStyle Hidden -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$($t.script)`"\"; Set-ScheduledTask -TaskName $t.name -Action $action -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host \"Updated $($t.name) to hidden PS\" }else{ Write-Host \"SKIP $($t.name) not found\" } }catch{ Write-Host \"ERROR $($t.name): $_\" } }; Write-Host 'cmd-006 done'"
commands.note: Re-register all Claude scheduled tasks to run via wscript run_hidden.vbs (window style 0) or -WindowStyle Hidden. Stops black box popup windows. Safe read-only to task scheduler.

commands.label: fix_popup_relay_back
commands.cmd: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Start-Sleep 5; $result=@{ts=(Get-Date -f 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ'); cmd='cmd-006'; status='executed'; tasks=(Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object {$_.TaskName -match 'Claude|SLC_|RelayAutoSync|Cloud_DC'} | ForEach-Object {$_.TaskName})}; $result|ConvertTo-Json|Out-File 'C:\Users\endos\Signal\relay\from_cli.json' -Encoding utf8"
commands.note: Write result back to from_cli.json so cloud can confirm popup fix was applied.
